messages.snippet: Rachel, Execution version of the SPA attached, incorporating the agreed package: 40 per cent. genera
messages.subject: Project Relay - SPA execution version & disclosure letter
messages.plaintextBody:
Rachel,

Execution version of the SPA attached, incorporating the agreed package: 40 per cent. general cap (100 per cent. overall), 21-month survival, 18-month non-compete / 24-month non-solicit, de minimis GBP 35,000, basket GBP 450,000, MAC with economic and industry carve-outs only, permitted leakage including transaction bonuses and adviser fees, escrow GBP 3,800,000 for 21 months, and W&I at clause 14 reflecting the bound GBP 19,000,000 policy.

The sellers' disclosure letter is also attached for review - it picks up the customer-concentration and vehicle-fleet (operating lease) points from diligence. Both to be dated 8 November.

Best,
Elena

--
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
